title: Neal Hefti brought west for a picture
summary: Neal Hefti was invited to Hollywood for his Basie sound, not at Carter's instigation.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: But of course that's just one particular case.

That's one particular case, but of course I know that Neal Hefty was invited out there under somewhat similar circumstances, not by any instigation of mine, but I know Dick Klein was telling me that when, I believe it was "Sex and the Single Girl" ... he wanted that sound that Hefty had been getting, you know, with the Basie thing, and he just picked up a phone one day and called Neal Hefty in New York, and said, "How would you like to come out and work on a picture for me?" It was just like that, and he came -- and you know, he did quite a succession of things, following that.
The Hollywood work goes on and off; I mean, it isn't something like a band where you're doing something every day and it's just a question of getting an assignment, so all this time ...
